definitions: Send a painful or unpleasant shock through (someone or something).
Have an unpleasant, discordant, or damaging effect.
Strike or collide with something, typically with a jarring effect.
Vibrate or shake, typically in an unpleasant way.
examples: The sudden noise jarred her nerves.
His harsh words jarred on her.
The car jarred against the curb.
The old engine jarred and rattled.
